verdict.rationale: RDAP records confirm Namecheap's own domain has DNSSEC delegation and DS data properly published at the registry (delegationSigned:true, zoneSigned:true, dsData present), showing DNSSEC signing does work end-to-end. However there is no documentation or evidence describing the actual signing workflow, whether it's one-click in the dashboard, or API-driven DS record automation. Missing for 10: documentation of the UI/API workflow for enabling DNSSEC, evidence of ease-of-use or one-click claims, and any independent confirmation from a security engineer's hands-on setup experience.
